title: BYD Passed Tesla To Lead The Global EV Race
hook: BYD quietly took the EV crown
source: Tesla quarterly delivery reports (battery-electric deliveries only). BYD company sales figures as compiled by CnEVPost/Reuters/InsideEVs (new-energy vehicles: battery-electric + plug-in hybrid combined). Different vehicle-mix definitions — Tesla's pure battery-electric sales stayed close behind BYD's even as BYD's combined new-energy total pulled far ahead from 2022 onward. Figures approximate, rounded to the nearest thousand.
